text: The site's twenty minutes out. Show the gate your regulator badge. You're a routine audit that came early.
style: Professional intelligence handler giving a mission briefing. Speak with a consistent British Received Pronunciation accent throughout — do not shift to any other accent. Use a steady, mid-range pitch. A seasoned professional who has done this a hundred times. Quick, clipped and businesslike because time is short, yet completely unflustered; the urgency is in the pace, never in the voice.
